thread:
micah: Heads-up — SLO dashboard for /v1/generate is triggering a ton of noisy alerts during our perf-canary. Pager volume up ~3x. Can we add a console-level mute or sampling for tenant-level SLO notifications?
anya: ugh saw that. Is this the tenant that hit runaway token cost or just transient latency?
micah: transient latency from bursty prefixes. Not a cost issue. Tenants sending long context sequences, KV cache warmups.
jamie_sre: recommend two quick levers: 1) short quiet window (30-60s) per-tenant 2) sample non-critical SLOs at 5-10% for noisy tenants, surface sampled hits in console telemetry.
kiran: API-wise we'd need a policy object. something like:
```json
{ "tenant_id": "T123", "slo_mute": { "window_s": 60, "reason": "warmup" }, "sampling": { "rate": 0.05 } }
```
consoleux: UI concern — we can't bury mute under advanced. Needs a preview showing who would be notified if we mute vs sample. Ops hates surprises.
micah: +1 on preview. Also need to show historical impact: how many notifications would have been suppressed in last 24h.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/notify-policy-api -> staging in 8m :rocket:
anya: routing question — if we mute at tenant level should we still route critical severity to oncall? e.g., data-loss or outage should bypass mute.
jamie_sre: yes bypass for severity >= P1. Mute only applies to P3/P4/metric-noise.
kiran: thinking about API surface: add `bypass_severities: ["P0","P1"]` and `preview_mode: true/false`. Keep policy evaluation server-side so experiments don't hit client SDKs.
consoleux: for rollout UX: allow canary on 10% of tenants and a toggle to force preview. Provide link-to-sample-prompt-set and a rendered diff of expected fanout.
micah: telemetry: we need an event indicating "slo_notify_decision" with fields {policy_id, tenant_id, decision, reason}. Keep it high-cardinality but sampled at ingestion.
jamie_sre: agree. Also emit a small histogram of suppressed vs emitted per policy to console.
ops-bot: incident digest: 3 suppressed alerts in last hour for T123, none were P1.
anya: implementation nit: can we reuse existing /notify/policies endpoint or add /notify/policies/eval? I'd prefer eval endpoint for preview without mutating state.
kiran: will add `POST /notify/policies/eval` that returns `would_notify: true/false` + traces. Good for automation tests.
consoleux: follow-up: show an inline "impact estimate" when editing policy: expected notifications/day, expected paging reduction, and historical false-positive ratio. Don't block — we can iterate.
micah: plan: kiran to prototype API & eval endpoint, jamie to sketch telemetry metrics, consoleux to wire up preview UI; we'll canary on 10 tenants for 48h.
kiran: I'll open draft PR and add sample payload and unit tests.
jamie_sre: I'll add Grafana panels for suppressed vs forwarded and a runbook note.
anya: tagging infra for quota interaction — we should ensure mute doesn't affect billing quotas, only alerting.
micah: correct — policy affects notifications only. Quotas/limits unchanged.
deploy-bot: feature/notify-policy-api -> staging deployed :white_check_mark:
micah: thanks all — hitting backlog to track follow-ups. :thumbsup:
